item.title: Linux App Summit 2026
item.description:
Overview

Organized the 10th Linux App Summit — a joint GNOME/KDE conference focused on encouraging app development for the Linux platform. Leading the outreach, fundraising, and social media campaign for the event.

Linux App Summit brings together developers, designers, distributions, and ecosystem maintainers to grow the Linux app ecosystem through technologies like Flatpak that enable direct app delivery to users.

Key Responsibilities & Results

  • 10th year organizing LAS and its predecessor, LAS GNOME — a showcase of GNOME and KDE working together
  • Social media transformation — replaced Buffer with Mixpost, a self-hosted social media platform with analytics, editorial workflow, and a collaborative workspace shared across the organizing team (now adopted by GNOME’s own accounts)
  • Multi-platform strategy — expanded beyond Mastodon to LinkedIn, BlueSky, YouTube, and Instagram with per-platform content strategies and goals
  • Influencer engagement — appeared on Tux Digital podcast with Aleix Pol (90 minutes, ~8k views), plus media partnerships with 9to5Linux, It’s FOSS, TuxDigital, and Linux Magazine
  • Record attendance — 110 in-person attendees (venue capacity 100), 156 registered, 71% conversion rate vs the 50% industry average for free events
  • Doubled online viewership — 2k + 2.7k views on the two conference days (more than 2x the previous year), 4.9k aggregate on individual talk videos, ~9.6k total
  • Organic content experiments — a spontaneous podcast-style YouTube conversation with Matthias Clasen (354 views) informed future video strategy

Impact

  • Proved the value of a data-driven, multi-platform outreach strategy for open source events
  • Built a reusable social media infrastructure (Mixpost) now serving GNOME’s own accounts
  • Established a model for breaking out of the fediverse into mainstream developer platforms

item.title: oneAPI DevSummit 2025 hosted by UXL Foundation 2025
item.description:
Conference Overview

The UXL DevSummit is a conference brand I created and managed during my tenure at Intel Corporation. The event’s format centers on community-driven content (80%), featuring developers and practitioners demonstrating their work with the oneAPI specification through live demos and technical talks, showcasing the ecosystem’s viability and real-world applications.

I developed the event playbook and served as Master of Ceremonies for this half-day summit, providing the run of show and executive oversight while a contractor handled day-to-day execution. I managed the live online conference, lending my voice and presence to create an engaging experience for attendees.

item.title: Linux App Summit 2025
item.description:
Project Overview

Linux App Summit is a pure community conference focused on encouraging developing apps on Linux. It brings together software engineers, designers, Linux distributions, and ecosystem maintainers to help educate, influence, and drive apps to app stores like FlatHub and the Snap Store. By building a robust ecosystem, we can build sustainable open source models that reward developers for their work.

Brief overview of the project.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the theme for each year
  • Outreach to developers and speakers
  • Fundraising and sponsorship

Impact

  • Excellent reception
  • Inteerst by other orgs to possibly help host the conference

item.title: Intel AI Summit 2025
item.description:
Conference Overview

Two-day AI focused developer summit focused on AI using Intel technologies. Unfortunately, with Intel laying off the developer relations team and the associated web team, there is no longer a specific link to the published agenda. However, video recordings are available.

Key Responsibilities

  • Co-hosted and served as Master of Ceremonies for both days
  • Opened and closed sessions with Susan Kahler
  • Participated as speaker in “Simplifying Generative AI App Development: Standardization Matters” session
  • Created run of show script
  • Managed every aspect of this conference

Impact

  • Two-day comprehensive AI developer conference
  • Featured 20+ technical sessions covering LLM deployment, RAG applications, AI PC development, and hands-on workshops
  • Brought together industry experts, researchers, and practitioners from diverse organizations

Video replay

Click on the video replay button and then on the right sidebar click on “From the series” and you should be able to get msot of content from this conference.

item.title: oneAPI DevSummit Hosted by UXL Foundation 2024
item.description:
Event Overview

Leading the organization of a multi-day virtual technology conference featuring keynotes, workshops, and networking opportunities over 300+ attendees. The event was considered a big success despite the challenge of a short deadline, moving the conference from an internal Intel conference to an industry conference with all new software tools.

Responsibilities

  • Program committee, Speaker outreach, and speaker selection
  • Organizing and coordinating visual assets
  • Coordinating Speaker outreach and communications
  • Coordinating and managing conference schedule with representatives of the UXL Foundation steering committee
  • Marketing and communications
  • Run of Show script
  • Working with event management company BrandLive.

Event Details

  • 300+ expected attendees
  • 2 days of sessions and workshops
  • 35+ speakers from around the world

Goals

Creating an inclusive, engaging event that strengthens our technology community and provides valuable learning opportunities.
